label: WRONG
reason: Members pin "pytest>=9.0.3,<10.0.0" in their dev `test` dependency group (core, openai, text-splitters, anthropic pyproject.toml). The lone outlier, langchain-tests (libs/standard-tests/pyproject.toml:28), is a pytest plugin library that lists pytest as a published runtime dependency, and it leaves the upper bound off its other pytest-ecosystem deps as well, so downstream packages can choose their own pytest. Leaving the cap off is deliberate and would recur for any shipped test-helper package. With 0 of 1 counted outliers a mistake, the label is WRONG. No lint or CI check enforces the pin; I also weighed mixed_group as the reason, since runtime deps and dev groups are mixed in one rule.
